definitions.explanation: A scheduled period of teaching or learning at a school or educational institution. Refers to the teaching session itself, not the subject or room.

examples.japanese: {授業|じゅぎょう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{何時|なんじ}→何時：00973_nanji⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{始|はじ}まります→始まる：00841_hajimaru⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
⟦{今日|きょう}→今日：00496_kyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{授業|じゅぎょう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{難|むずか}しかった→難しい：00517_muzukashii⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
{授業|じゅぎょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{遅|おく}れて→遅れる：00741_okureru⟧⟦しまいました→しまう：03064_shimau⟧。
examples.english: I ended up being late to class.

examples.english: What time is the afternoon class from and to?

examples.japanese: ⟦{先生|せんせい}→先生：00609_sensei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{授業|じゅぎょう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦いつも→いつも：00599_itsumo⟧⟦{面白|おもしろ}くて→面白い：00589_omoshiroi⟧、⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{早|はや}く→早い：00514_hayai⟧⟦{過|す}ぎる→過ぎる：01219_sugiru⟧。
examples.english: The teacher's class is always interesting, so time passes quickly.

notes:
{授業|じゅぎょう} refers to a class or lesson in an educational setting. It emphasizes the teaching session itself rather than the subject matter.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {授業|じゅぎょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}ける→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧: to attend/take a class (student's perspective)
- {授業|じゅぎょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to teach a class (teacher's perspective)
- {授業|じゅぎょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧: to attend class
- {授業|じゅぎょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{休|やす}む→休む：00606_yasumu⟧: to miss/skip class

- {授業|じゅぎょう}{中|ちゅう}: during class
- {課外|かがい}{授業|じゅぎょう}: extracurricular lesson
